name: EPIC 248547508
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.5 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248547508 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.539174 (16th-84th percentiles 9.231881-9.868447), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248547508: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4680.9585 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248547508 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3253.710938 (16th-84th percentiles 3174.648438-3335.820312), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.05 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,254 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.05 solar masses and 9.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,681 K at its surface.
